lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Town Council's June 30 meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's Wildfire Resiliency Code will set the terms for how development and fire risk are managed in this box canyon going forward — worth showing up for. Also on June 25, the Hospital District board digs into mill levy considerations as the push for a new facility continues, and P&Z holds a work session on the Shandoka Lot redevelopment, the major Town-owned site Design Workshop has been planning.

notable.stake: Mill levy discussion directly affects how the hospital district is funded.
Early feedback shapes the Town's biggest redevelopment project before formal review.
Wildfire code amendments and two property sales get council votes.
